name: Mishti Doi
ingredients: Sugar (preferably Nolen Gur or Jaggery for authentic taste)
instructions: 1. Boil the milk over low heat until it reduces to about two-thirds of its original volume, stirring constantly.
2. In a separate pan, heat sugar until it turns into a deep golden brown caramel.
3. Slowly pour the thickened milk into the caramel, stirring well until fully dissolved and cooled to lukewarm temperature.
4. Whisk in the curd starter until smooth.
5. Pour the mixture into a clean earthen clay pot.
6. Cover and keep in a warm, undisturbed place for 8-10 hours until set, then refrigerate before serving.
description: Mishti Doi is the hallmark of Bengali hospitality and dessert culture. Traditionally set in porous clay pots which absorb excess moisture and provide an earthy aroma, it is a celebratory staple often served after elaborate meals during festivals like Durga Puja and weddings.
